headline: US Lawmakers Pledge Push to Overturn Administration Tariff Policies
summary: Multiple US lawmakers have vowed to push legislation to reverse President Donald Trump's tariff measures following recent election developments.
why: US trade policy and tariffs directly influence global supply chains, international trade volumes, and corporate input costs across diverse sectors.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Potential legislative challenges introduce uncertainty into existing US tariff regimes and trade agreements.
